description: AMS Climate at a Glance Application is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by American Meteorological Society Education Program; NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. Statistical analyses can help you tell if observed changes in temperature and precipitation are due to climate variability or climate change NOAA succinctly defines climate change as “a long-term shift in the statistics of the weather (including its averages).” Climatologists generally rely on 30-year averages of climate elements, updated at the beginning of each new ... Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
